title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: MAC > CDR from Jim Wise. CDR > EAC > WavMerge > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: Beyers M160's > Sony TC-D5, near the Sbd > MAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show captured on an excellent audience tape – the mix is solid (though Phil sits low) and features smoking Bertha, Mexicali Blues, Eyes of the World and Earthquake Space.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, highlighting Jerry’s incendiary guitar work from the Bertha opener through a blistering Eyes of the World, plus tight interplay on Cold Rain & Snow and Playin' in the Band. The audience source is praised for its clarity and well‑balanced mix despite Phil’s bass being a bit recessed, making this a very listenable document of a standout 1982 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high marks (5 and 4 stars) focus on strong musical performance and good recording quality; weighted rating yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix with Jerry front‑and‑center; Phil’s bass is low in the mix but overall the tape captures the band cleanly without major dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds nicely from a punchy Bertha opener through a series of tightly linked jams, culminating in an expansive Earthquake Space and Reprise that keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Warmed up on Bertha, delivered hot picking, super‑fast strumming, and dazzling leads especially on Eyes of the World; often front‑and‑center in the mix.
band_member_comments.Phil: Playing spot‑on and drives Earthquake Space, but his bass sits low in the overall mix throughout the tour.
band_member_comments.Bob: Kept in the shadows yet contributes solidly; good interplay with Jerry and Brent.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent on church organ adds a throwback feel to Cold Rain & Snow and locks in tightly with Jerry during Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s cymbal work is strong, drummers ready for launch at 10:50, providing a solid rhythmic foundation.
